title: One release, a clearer picture of the work ahead.
summary: The first weekly development report brings node reliability, explorer improvements and the EVM, DEX, bridge and aggregator work into one dated record. The next node binary remains in consolidation.
highlights: Explorer transaction lookup, exact receipt accounting and analytical charts were published on 16 September.
Persistent node recovery passed local state-equivalence and crash-restart tests. Linux and current-mainnet qualification remain open.
EVM, native DEX, bridge and aggregator development are being consolidated before selecting the next node release.

tracks.name: Node & consensus
tracks.current: The published Genesis-4 binary is the 14 September release. A local candidate adds persistent committed state, bounded tail replay, corrupt-cache fallback and incomplete-log recovery.
tracks.next: Reconcile development branches with released consensus history; qualify the pinned Linux build, mixed versions and recovery against the complete current log.
tracks.evidence: Local candidate: 382 node tests and 423 committee debug tests passed. These do not establish a production recovery SLA.

tracks.name: Explorer & indexer
tracks.current: Transaction lookup now distinguishes missing receipts from service failures, preserves exact integer accounting and shows allocation charts. Analytics adds epoch activity, slot fill and proposer coverage.
tracks.next: Continue historical indexer coverage and source-freshness validation; avoid treating unavailable or partial data as zero.
tracks.evidence: Explorer production deployment and fixture-based browser checks completed on 16 September.

tracks.name: EVM execution
tracks.current: Signed EVM execution, local developer examples and experimental Reth storage integration are implemented. A local EVM is distinct from settlement on Bloch.
tracks.next: Complete native settlement, authenticated finality and proof integration; qualify the complete execution and state-restoration path.
tracks.evidence: Source review of the modular execution README and delivery plan; production Bloch settlement is not established.

tracks.name: DEX & native pools
tracks.current: PosternDEX has an external-EVM interface. Separately, native Bloch assets, pool custody and canonical transaction integration are being developed behind inactive or laboratory gates.
tracks.next: Unify the released consensus baseline, integrate all pool state with restart/reorg recovery, finish cross-component tests and review an activation plan.
tracks.evidence: An external-chain DEX interface is not evidence that native Bloch pools are active.

tracks.name: Bridge & stablecoins
tracks.current: Reference bridge components, local roundtrips and read-only deposit/release observers exist. Native gateway operations retain explicit custody and authorization boundaries.
tracks.next: Authenticate finality, finalize production routes and custody, reconcile backing and redemptions, and complete independent review before enabling public native deposits.
tracks.evidence: No public Bloch bridge deposit or withdrawal service is claimed by this report.

tracks.name: Wallet & aggregator
tracks.current: The wallet includes LI.FI route comparison and a restricted Across ETH execution/recovery path. Current source also adds local signing and receipt-bound delivery checks.
tracks.next: Complete the intended route and wallet matrix, rejection/recovery tests and source/destination receipt checks. Keep external-EVM routes separate from native Bloch settlement.
tracks.evidence: Scope follows the wallet README and recent implementation commits; this report does not qualify every route or asset.

roadmap.title: Freeze a compatible node candidate
roadmap.detail: Collect final agent commits, preserve live activation rules and test old and new nodes together.

roadmap.title: Make restart predictable
roadmap.detail: Finish cache-version policy, cold genesis/carryover initialization, snapshot cost and resource limits; measure real Linux recovery.

roadmap.title: Connect EVM execution to native settlement
roadmap.detail: Complete authenticated state/finality and the proof/settlement boundary beyond local execution.

roadmap.title: Complete native DEX and bridge integration
roadmap.detail: Cover pool reserves, gateway liabilities, replay protection and all state in atomic execution, reorgs and persistent recovery.

roadmap.title: Qualify wallet and aggregator delivery
roadmap.detail: Verify supported networks, quote execution, rejection paths and receipt-based recovery for the defined integration scope.

roadmap.title: Publish one tested binary with operator guidance
roadmap.detail: Pin source, compiler, features and hashes; run a standby/canary, retain rollback instructions and coordinate independent validators.
